title: Peter Yang /human-review skill: local visual editor for HTML and Markdown
summary: Peter Yang launches /human-review, a free skill that opens HTML and Markdown in a local visual editor for inline text edits, image resizing, and Google-Doc-style comment pins the agent consumes. Follow-up to /no-ai-slop; review loop stays local.
question_it_answers: How does Peter Yang's /human-review skill let me edit agent HTML visually instead of via chat?

claims.text: Skill opens HTML and Markdown in a visual editor with direct text edit, image resize, and comment pins.
claims.evidence:
Edit and format text directly
→ Resize images
→ Leave comments for AI like a Google Doc
